# Aryan Gupta Portfolio

Aryan Gupta is a systems engineer and full-stack developer based in India. At Infosys, he monitors Grafana and Splunk dashboards for IKEA web, app, and in-store systems, raises incident tickets, and reports issues or downtime to the responsible teams. This portfolio documents his experience, skills, shipped projects, awards, and contact options.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio](https://www.lagaryan.click/): Experience, skills, selected projects, and contact links.
- [Terminal portfolio](https://www.lagaryan.click/cli): Plain-text portfolio for terminal clients.
- [Projects](https://www.lagaryan.click/#projects): Selected shipped work and source links.
- [Nail Bar by Kritika](https://www.lagaryan.click/projects/nailbar-by-kritika): Client website, local SEO, and Google Business Profile work for a nail salon and academy in Karnal.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.lagaryan.click/privacy-policy): Analytics and privacy information.
